mission.goal: Connect exact retained XML/RTP tracks, lifecycle and vendor-zone analysis to canonical AOP-005 queries through a real read-only source owner.

authority.git: User explicitly authorized meaningful frequent direct-main GitHub commits, no PRs; preserve concurrent main with expected-head updates.
authority.read_owner: Existing operator-selected deployment only; exact immutable source roots, metadata-only history, no publisher recovery/writer lock/repair/acquisition/derived publication/effect reconciliation.

published_checkpoints.change: Shared frozen source reconstruction, genuine read-only two-pass analysis, canonical AOP-005 context and complete redacted semantic rows.
Canonical CLI/MCP ONVIF target, closed inline selector schema, same native source owner/renderer and actual-process parity tests.

contracts.pins: ordered exact XML/RTP identity/root pairs, duplicate identities refused, each independent source a continuity barrier
contracts.privacy: Raw lexical vendor values/UUIDs/source bytes withheld; original handles, barriers, uncertainty and explicit operator zone policy retained. No source hydration grant.
contracts.compatibility: Old source bytes/generations, projection identities, public retained-owner APIs and original read/callback order preserved; new query domains bind its different read owner and accounting.
contracts.complete_rows: All source/frame/occurrence/tracklet rows plus all selected lifecycle document/operation/endpoint/support/behaviour/reuse rows or zone policy/cell/frame/transition rows; 1..32 or whole-query refusal.
contracts.cli: fss query --target onvif --analysis tracks|lifecycle|zones --sources <inline JSON>; zones requires inline --zone-policy.
contracts.mcp: Existing query tool target onvif, no parallel tool. Operator launch root/principal are fixed; the per-call selector is closed.
contracts.transport: Existing query/case canonical response shared byte-for-byte across native renderer, CLI and MCP. Outer response cap 256 KiB, cooperative 60-second deadline with post-render delivery gate.

budgets.source_checks: All initial reads and finish-root payload rehashes in both passes use one real reader; no allowance refill.
budgets.cancellation: Phase/source-I/O checkpoints. The final checkpoint admits bounded synchronous history reconstruction followed by pure assembly without caller callbacks. Cancellation/deadline during this finalization requires caller delivery gating; canonical CLI gates after rendering. No interruptible final-history claim.

Canonical queries need complete uncertainty-preserving rows and existing envelopes, not parallel MCP tools.
A late arbitrary callback after captured authority is unsafe; finalization admission and transport delivery gating remain distinct.

Continuous metadata capture requires a provisional-to-durable identity contract.

Vendor claims and derived geometry/lineage do not establish physical identity, occupancy, absence, trusted time or effects.
invalidations: Changed root/closure/source generation/site/history/effect prefix/deletion state, cancellation at admission or exhausted read/work/output capacity refuses the query.
No missing root initialization, repair, acquisition or policy activation occurs.
